artist.name: NATASHA DIGGS
artist.bio: Natasha Diggs is a New York City DJ and the resident of the Soul in the Horn party series. She plays soul, funk, hip-hop, disco and Latin records, mostly on vinyl. She was the official DJ on Lauryn Hill's 2015 international tour.

eras.sound: Horn-driven records across Afrobeat, jazz, disco and house
